title.value: The KNOWREF Coreference Corpus: Removing Gender and Number Cues for Difficult Pronominal Anaphora Resolution
title.justification: The title is clearly mentioned at the beginning of the paper, along with the list of authors and their affiliations.
title.quote: The K NOW R EF Coreference Corpus: Removing Gender and Number Cues for Difficult Pronominal Anaphora Resolution

analysis.description: The paper introduces the KNOWREF corpus, a new benchmark for coreference resolution that aims to challenge existing models by removing gender and number cues and requiring higher-level common sense and contextual understanding. The corpus contains 8,724 sentences designed to be more difficult for models to resolve than traditional datasets. This research is aimed at making model predictions rely more on context and world knowledge, rather than surface features.

type.justification: The study involves empirical evaluations of existing models on the newly introduced corpus and observes their performance. It provides data-based insights and experimental results.
type.quote: We present a corpus of over 8,000 annotated text passages with ambiguous pronominal anaphora... We show that various coreference systems... perform significantly worse on the task than humans.

name.quote: We introduce a new benchmark for coreference resolution and NLI, K NOW R EF , that targets common-sense understanding and world knowledge.
